# Boldface

> Boldface is a LinkedIn agency based in Bangalore, India, for founders, CEOs, CFOs, consultants and executives. It runs LinkedIn end to end: profile and positioning, ghostwritten posts, newsletters, strategic networking, collaborations and events, company pages and leadership teams, plus one-off audits and workshops. Clients are across India, Dubai and Abu Dhabi, with others in the UK and Singapore.

Key facts:
- Founded and led by Koushik Agarwalla (curator and execution lead), who plans, writes and runs every engagement. Brand strategy advisor: Sandeep Komarla (former AVP Disney Star, Senior Director Viacom18, Marketing Head Radio City).
- 35+ founders, CEOs and executives worked with over four years; 265K+ followers built and 55M+ organic impressions across clients.
- Pricing: Monthly retainers start from ₹15,000 to ₹18,000 a month, depending on scope. Larger engagements are priced on a call.
- Engagements are monthly retainers with 30 days' notice. No lock-in.
- Every post is written in the client's voice and approved by the client before it goes out. Clients typically spend under 30 minutes a week.
- Networking is done by hand. Boldface never uses LinkedIn automation tools or engagement pods.
- First call to first post in 21 days.
- Boldface does not offer traditional PR or press pitching; it focuses entirely on LinkedIn.
- Contact: koushik@boldface.click, WhatsApp +91 70772 47111, book a free 30 minute call at https://calendly.com/boldfaceonline/30min

## Services
- [LinkedIn Profile Optimisation](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-profile-optimisation/): LinkedIn profile optimisation done properly: positioning, headline, About, Featured and experience rewritten so the right people get you in ten seconds. For founders and leaders in India and the UAE.
- [LinkedIn Ghostwriting and Content Management](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-ghostwriting/): LinkedIn ghostwriting for founders, CEOs and executives: 8 to 12 posts a month in your voice, plus carousels, short video and articles. Planned, written, designed and posted for you.
- [LinkedIn Newsletter Management](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-newsletter-management/): We name, set up, plan, write and grow your LinkedIn newsletter. Every issue in your voice, published on schedule, with subscriber growth built in. For founders and executives.
- [Strategic LinkedIn Networking](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-networking/): Strategic LinkedIn networking done by people, not bots: a target list of investors, buyers and partners, personal connection notes, thoughtful comments and DM replies drafted for you.
- [LinkedIn Collaborations, Lives and Events](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-collaborations/): Grow on LinkedIn by borrowing the right audiences: co-written posts with peers, podcast and LinkedIn Live guest spots, LinkedIn events and paid brand partnerships, set up and run for you.
- [LinkedIn Company Page Management](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-company-page-management/): LinkedIn company page management that works through your people: page content and growth, leadership team profiles and posts, and employee posts made easy to share. One story across every account.
- [LinkedIn Audit and Workshops](https://boldface.online/services/linkedin-audit/): A LinkedIn audit of your profile and content with a written fix list ranked by impact, or a hands-on LinkedIn workshop for your leadership team. For people who'd rather do it themselves.

## Who it's for
- [LinkedIn Personal Branding for Startup Founders](https://boldface.online/for/founders/): LinkedIn personal branding for startup founders: positioning, ghostwritten posts, networking with investors and buyers, and a profile that sells before you speak. India, Dubai and Abu Dhabi.
- [Executive Branding on LinkedIn for CEOs and the C-suite](https://boldface.online/for/ceos/): Executive branding and LinkedIn ghostwriting for CEOs, CTOs, COOs and the C-suite: positioning, posts in your voice, a newsletter and networking, with under 30 minutes of your time a week.
- [LinkedIn Personal Branding for CFOs and Finance Leaders](https://boldface.online/for/cfos/): LinkedIn for CFOs and finance leaders: a profile that shows your judgement, posts that make finance readable, and a network that brings board roles, speaking invitations and advisory work.
- [LinkedIn for Consultants, Coaches, CAs and Legal Advisors](https://boldface.online/for/consultants/): LinkedIn for consultants, coaches, chartered accountants and legal advisors: positioning, ghostwritten posts and networking that bring in clients who already understand what you do.

## The Playbook (free guides)
- [LinkedIn personal branding for founders in India: the complete guide](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-personal-branding-for-founders-india/): The complete guide to LinkedIn personal branding for founders in India: positioning, profile, what to post, newsletters, networking, collaborations, timelines and measuring what matters.
- [How to write a hook that does not start with I](https://boldface.online/playbook/how-to-write-a-linkedin-hook/): How to write a LinkedIn hook that stops the scroll, and why the first line should almost never start with I. Practical examples from the Boldface Playbook.
- [The 5 post types that actually generate inbound](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-post-types-that-generate-inbound/): Most LinkedIn content earns likes, not business. The five post types that actually generate inbound for founders, executives and consultants.
- [LinkedIn profile optimisation: a section by section checklist](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-profile-optimisation-checklist/): A complete LinkedIn profile optimisation checklist for founders and executives: photo, banner, headline, About, Featured, experience, skills and recommendations, section by section.
- [Why your LinkedIn bio is quietly killing your credibility](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-headline-and-about-section/): Your LinkedIn headline and About section decide your credibility in three seconds. How to rewrite both so the right people take you seriously.
- [How to start a LinkedIn newsletter people actually open](https://boldface.online/playbook/how-to-start-a-linkedin-newsletter/): How to start a LinkedIn newsletter that people open: picking a name and angle, how often to publish, what to write, and how to grow subscribers without begging.
- [How to network on LinkedIn without being that person](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-networking-without-spam/): How to network on LinkedIn without spamming: build a target list, comment before you connect, write connection notes that get accepted, and turn DMs into meetings.
- [What a LinkedIn ghostwriter actually does, and how to work with one](https://boldface.online/playbook/what-a-linkedin-ghostwriter-does/): What does a LinkedIn ghostwriter do? How ghostwriting works for founders and executives, how voice is captured, how much time it takes you, and how to get great results.
- [How to build a content strategy in 90 minutes](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-content-strategy-in-90-minutes/): How to build a LinkedIn content strategy in one 90 minute sitting: pillars, formats and a rhythm you can actually keep up.
- [What actually gets reach on LinkedIn in 2026](https://boldface.online/playbook/what-gets-reach-on-linkedin/): What gets reach on LinkedIn in 2026: what we see working across client accounts, from expertise and comments to formats, timing and the habits that quietly kill your reach.
- [The comment that got me three clients in one week](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-commenting-strategy/): Strategic commenting is the most underused growth lever on LinkedIn. How one comment led to three clients in a week, and how to do it yourself.
- [Company page or personal profile: where should founders post?](https://boldface.online/playbook/company-page-vs-personal-profile/): Should founders post on the LinkedIn company page or their personal profile? What each one is for, why personal posts usually reach further, and how to run both together.
- [The C-suite guide to LinkedIn](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-for-c-suite-executives/): The C-suite guide to LinkedIn: why your absence online costs you board roles, hires and deals, and what to do about it without becoming a creator.
- [The personal brand toolkit every CFO should have](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-personal-brand-for-cfos/): The personal brand toolkit every CFO should have: what to post, how to position yourself and why finance leaders are the most underused voices on LinkedIn.
- [LinkedIn agency, freelancer or in-house: which should you hire?](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-agency-vs-freelancer-vs-in-house/): Should you hire a LinkedIn agency, a freelance ghostwriter or someone in-house? An honest comparison of cost, quality, voice, consistency and control for founders and executives.
- [How to choose a LinkedIn agency in India: 10 questions to ask first](https://boldface.online/playbook/how-to-choose-a-linkedin-agency-india/): How to choose the best LinkedIn agency in India for you: ten questions to ask about who writes, automation, voice, reporting, contracts and results before you sign.
- [How to write about failure on LinkedIn without it backfiring](https://boldface.online/playbook/writing-about-failure-on-linkedin/): Failure posts are some of the most powerful content on LinkedIn and the most often botched. How to write about failure without it backfiring.
- [Why consistency beats brilliance on LinkedIn every single time](https://boldface.online/playbook/linkedin-consistency/): Why consistency beats brilliance on LinkedIn. The strongest personal brands aren't built by the best writers but by the people who keep showing up.
